items.originalTitle: Guenther Steiner expects Ferrari board to react after Lewis Hamilton-Charles Leclerc clash
detailZh: 格恩特·斯特尼尔预计法拉利董事会将在刘易斯·汉密尔顿-查尔斯·勒克莱尔冲突后作出反应
查尔斯·勒克莱尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第六名的争夺中导致刘易斯·汉密尔顿打转
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
对于法拉利车迷来说。最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远处的赛事反应。
前哈斯一级方程式车队负责人古恩特·施泰纳认为，法拉利车队将在刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上再次发生冲突后做出改变。
勒克莱尔在拉斯维加斯街道上与汉密尔顿争夺第六名时将汉密尔顿旋转了一圈，这发生在墨西哥大奖赛上另一次冲突后的三周。勒克莱尔被处罚，最终排名第10，汉密尔顿排名第7，车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔称这"完全不能接受"。
"显然，这是不能接受的。首先，有一点和墨西哥一样，因为你要考虑车队，考虑在马拉内洛工作的所有人，考虑所有利益相关者，包括赞助商，"瓦瑟尔在比赛后对天空体育说。
"我们传达了信息给查尔斯，让他不要超车，因为在这样的比赛中，正如你之前说的，你必须超越前面的车，否则就会被别人超越。这意味着你必须完成你的比赛。"
“查尔斯，这显然是一个对车队造成很大惩罚的错误。在今天这是完全不能接受的。老实说，我非常生气，因为墨西哥站之后那个信息已经很明确了。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、查尔斯·勒克莱尔、法拉利
在《红旗播客》上讨论碰撞事件时，斯特尼尔表示：“会有所改变的。”他承认自己不知道具体时间，并补充说：“你能想象昨天法拉利董事会的情况吗？”
斯特尼尔认为，解决这种情况的责任并不完全在于车队总监。
“我已经说过好几次了，这不仅仅是因为弗雷德。有一大群决策者，”斯特尼尔说。
“这不仅是在两位车手和弗雷德之间讨论。这是在董事会中讨论。每个人都会对如何处理这件事有自己的看法。
“在董事会中，真正能够做出决定的人会有不同的意见，因此，不会有结论。”
“赛季还剩下两轮，法拉利在车队积分榜上以517分排名第二。红牛以440分排名第三，而迈凯轮以431分排名第四。梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛中夺得了冠军。”
detailEn: Guenther Steiner expects Ferrari board to react after Lewis Hamilton-Charles Leclerc clash
Charles Leclerc spun Lewis Hamilton during their fight for sixth at the Las Vegas Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner believes Ferrari will make changes after Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc clashed again at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Leclerc spun Hamilton around while the pair fought over sixth place around the streets of Las Vegas, only three weeks after another clash at the Mexican Grand Prix. Leclerc was penalised and finished 10th, with Hamilton seventh, and team principal Fred Vasseur called it "completely unacceptable".

"Clearly, it's unacceptable. First, a little bit the same message as Mexico, because you have to think about the team, about the people working in Maranello, about all the stakeholders, the sponsors," Vasseur told Sky Sports after the race.

"We passed the message to Charles to not overtake, because in this kind of race, as you were saying before, you have to overtake the cars in front of you or you are passed by the others. It means that you have to do your race.
"And Charles, it's clearly a mistake that is penalising the team a lot. And it's completely unacceptable today. Honestly, I'm more than upset because that message was clear after Mexico."
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari
Discussing the clash on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner said: "Something will change." He admitted he did not know the timing, adding: "Can you imagine in the Ferrari boardroom after yesterday?"
Steiner argued that the responsibility for resolving the situation does not rest solely with the team chief.
"I said it already a few times, it's not only down to Fred. There is a big group of decision-makers," Steiner said.
"This is not only discussed between the two drivers and Fred. This is discussed in the boardroom. Every man and his dog will have an opinion about how it should be dealt with.
"In the boardroom, the people who actually can decide will have different opinions, and therefore, there will be no conclusion."

With two rounds remaining in the season, Ferrari sits second in the constructors' championship with 517 points. Red Bull is third on 440 points and McLaren fourth with 431 points. Mercedes claimed the title at the Brazilian Grand Prix.

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff: Las Vegas was “Indy 500, NASCAR and Formula 1 mixed”
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said after the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix that the race was like "Indy 500 and NASCAR and Formula 1 mixed" and urged critics to stay open-minded. Even after both Mercedes drivers slipped off the podium in the final three laps, he was thrilled by the spectacle.
detailZh: 沃尔夫称拉斯维加斯站像“印地500、纳斯卡与F1混合”
托托·沃尔夫将2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛比作“印地500、纳斯卡和F1混合”，并呼吁批评者保持开放态度
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发和比赛分析。
尽管两位梅赛德斯车手在最后三圈跌出领奖台，车队领队托托·沃尔夫在离开2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛时仍对这场比赛的观赏性感到兴奋。
尽管批评者质疑F1的2026年能量管理规则是否让周六晚间那场35次领先易主的战斗变得有些人为，沃尔夫却认为，这项赛事不应轻视车迷刚刚目睹的一切。
“这些规则带来了极佳的娱乐性，我们见证了一场超级精彩的比赛，尤其是对美国观众而言，”沃尔夫在赛后媒体采访中表示。“我觉得这就像是印地500、纳斯卡和F1的混合体！”
当被直接问及频繁的尾流交换是否过于偏向人为制造的比赛时，沃尔夫指向了维修区墙外的反应——包括他的妻子、F1学院董事总经理苏西·沃尔夫，以及F1首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利。
“是的，我的意思是，我猜会有很多人说，‘好吧，这不算赛车。’就我个人而言，我们需要保持开放的心态，”沃尔夫说。“苏西当时在围场俱乐部，她说整整90分钟里，人们都在为超车尖叫。你都不太确定自己是否还占着位置。我从观看比赛的朋友、我们的赞助商那里得到的即时反馈是，太棒了。斯特凡诺（多梅尼卡利）非常喜欢。”
“这种情况不会在所有地方发生，”他补充道。“从某种意义上说，这很适合拉斯维加斯的比赛——纳斯卡、印地500，就像我说的，全都聚在一起。说实话，我不知道比赛持续了多久，90分钟。对我来说，感觉就像20分钟，因为比赛如此不同，观看如此有趣。”
尽管梅赛德斯后期崩盘，仍对维斯塔潘表示赞赏
马克斯·维斯塔潘以1小时27分39.624秒赢得这场50圈的比赛——略低于90分钟——在迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯（+0.639秒）和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（+1.529秒）之前，夺得他第三次拉斯维加斯胜利。
梅赛德斯自己的领奖台冲刺在短时间内接连消失。第48圈，乔治·拉塞尔在5号弯攻击队友基米·安东内利时，在脏线上锁死，滑入护栏，随后恢复比赛并最终获得第九名——沃尔夫称这一举动为“一次误判”。片刻之后，安东内利在维斯塔潘身后的大直道上收油并重新给油，试图保持超车模式，耗尽了他的电池，从第二名跌至第四名。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
沃尔夫透露，梅赛德斯原本为安东内利在左侧弯道后的最后400米保留了一件“压箱底的武器”，但在那次失误之前，他仍将全部功劳归于红牛的获胜者。“马克斯是当之无愧的赢家，”沃尔夫说。“他没有犯任何错误，这就是他赢得比赛的原因。”
由于梅赛德斯已在巴西提前锁定2026年车队总冠军，并在进入下周末卡塔尔大奖赛前以149分（666比517）领先法拉利，沃尔夫有资本享受这场混乱——他称拉斯维加斯大道的尾流对决“非常真实”。
detailEn: Toto Wolff: Las Vegas was “Indy 500, NASCAR and Formula 1 mixed”
Toto Wolff compares the 2026 Las Vegas GP to "Indy 500 and NASCAR and Formula 1 mixed" and urges critics to stay open
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Even after watching both Mercedes drivers slip off the podium in the final three laps, team principal Toto Wolff left the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix thrilled by the spectacle.

While critics questioned whether Formula 1’s 2026 energy-management rules turned Saturday night’s 35-lead-change battle into something artificial, Wolff argued the series should not dismiss what fans had just witnessed.
"These regs are great entertainment, and we saw a mega race, particularly for the Americans," Wolff said in his post-race media session. "I guess it was Indy 500 and NASCAR and Formula 1 mixed!"

Asked directly if the constant slipstream swaps leaned too far into artificial racing, Wolff pointed to the reaction away from the pitwall - including from his wife, F1 Academy managing director Susie Wolff, and Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali.

"Yeah, I mean, I guess you will have many people that will say, 'Well, that’s not racing.' Personally, we need to be open-minded," Wolff said. "Susie was in Paddock Club, and she said that for 90 minutes, people [were] screaming with the overtakes. You were not quite sure whether you had the position or not. The instant feedback I got from friends watching, our sponsors, was that it was awesome. Stefano [Domenicali] liked it very much.

"That’s not going to happen everywhere," he added. "In a way, it’s fitting that that was the Las Vegas race - NASCAR, Indy 500, like I said, all together. To be honest, I don’t know how long the race was 90 minutes. For me, it was like 20 minutes, because it was so different and so entertaining to watch."
Praise for Verstappen despite Mercedes’ late collapse
Max Verstappen won the 50-lap race in 1h27m39.624s - just under 90 minutes - to claim his third Las Vegas victory ahead of McLaren’s Lando Norris (+0.639 seconds) and Oscar Piastri (+1.529s).

Mercedes’ own podium charge vanished in quick succession. On lap 48, George Russell locked up on the dirty line at Turn 5 while attacking team-mate Kimi Antonelli, sliding into the barrier and recovering to ninth - a move Wolff called "a misjudgement". Moments later, Antonelli lifted and reapplied throttle down the back straight trying to hold overtake mode behind Verstappen, draining his battery and tumbling from second to fourth.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

Wolff revealed Mercedes had saved "a last weapon up our sleeve for the final 400 metres over the left kink" for Antonelli before the error, yet gave full credit to Red Bull’s winner. "Max is a deserving winner," Wolff said. "He made no mistakes, and that's why he won the race."

With Mercedes already crowned 2026 constructors’ champions in Brazil and holding a 149-point lead over Ferrari (666 to 517) entering next weekend’s Qatar Grand Prix, Wolff could afford to enjoy the chaos - calling the Strip’s slipstream duel "very authentic" for Las Vegas.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen’s deadpan reaction to winning F1’s Overtake of the Month award
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘对赢得F1本月超越奖的平淡反应
马克斯·维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯舞台上赢得F1十月超越奖后给出了平淡的反应
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的分析与比赛解析。
马克斯·维斯塔潘从不擅长做作的表现，F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛的粉丝论坛又给了我们一个提醒。
出现在红牛车队在拉斯维加斯的浅色队服上，与队友伊萨克·哈德贾以及哈斯车队的奥利弗·贝尔曼和拉斐尔·卡马拉一起站在舞台上，这位四次世界冠军获得了一块额外的奖牌——并以极致的冷静回应。
“你可能知道接下来会发生什么，马克斯，”舞台主持人调侃着，观众欢呼。‘我不知道，’维斯塔潘平淡地回答。
当她宣布他赢得了Formula 1的‘本月超越奖’并递给他一个清晰的圆形奖杯供投票粉丝签名时，维斯塔潘只是发出了一声低沉的‘哦’，然后回头看向巨幕重放的获胜动作：他在马来西亚巴林大奖赛上超越梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利。
即使是维斯塔潘也对粉丝投票表示怀疑。
“那不可能赢，”他通过麦克风说，同时回头看着重放。站在他左边，贝尔曼 立即插话：“这是这个月吗？那感觉像是两个月前。”
维斯塔潘 持着签名的奖杯向主持人问道：“这是哪个月的？”
“十月，”她回答道。
“十月。好吧，”维斯塔潘 嘟囔着，停顿了一下，然后带着完全严肃的表情半心半意地将奖杯举到空中，并单调地说：“是的！”观众爆发出欢呼和笑声，主持人开玩笑说：“我们接受这个，Max！我们会接受的。”
Sepang赛道——以及拉斯维加斯的超越讽刺
贝尔曼的时间线俏皮话并不离谱。移师至马来西亚雪邦国际赛道的巴林大奖赛在10月4日举行，比原定时间提前了近七周，这是自2017年赛事从中东移出后，一级方程式赛车首次重返该场地。
尽管维斯塔潘的反应平淡，但这次变动本身对红牛车队本赛季来说至关重要。由于大雨和排位赛软件故障，比赛开始被推迟了超过90分钟，发车时杆位车手维斯塔潘在起跑线上落后于安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔。
在瓦尔特里·博塔斯引发的第一次安全车出动后——当时红牛车队在梅赛德斯车队的中胎轮胎上选择了软胎——维斯塔潘在复赛后，在第一弯道外侧无情地超越了安东内利。他一路领先，以2.307秒的优势击败安东内利，这不仅为他赢得了2026年的首个胜利，也为红牛福特动力系统赢得了突破性的处女冠。
粉丝投票让维斯塔潘在6月和7月之前赢得的第三个月度超越奖杯后，成为了赛季领先每月获胜者，进入年终超越奖评选。
更令人印象深刻的是，周六晚上的喜剧舞台瞬间迅速过时。维斯塔潘在一场混乱的50圈比赛中赢得了2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛，这场比赛创下了352次超越和35次领先变化的新纪录——然而他却称电池驱动的滑流战斗"不是F1"。如果粉丝再给他11月的奖杯，预计他的反应会更平淡。
detailEn: Max Verstappen’s deadpan reaction to winning F1’s Overtake of the Month award
Max Verstappen gives a deadpan reaction on the Las Vegas stage after winning F1's October Overtake of the Month award
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Max Verstappen has never been one for forced showmanship, and Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix Fan Forum offered another reminder.

Appearing on stage in Red Bull’s tan Las Vegas teamwear alongside team-mate Isack Hadjar and Haas drivers Oliver Bearman and Rafael Camara, the four-time world champion was awarded an extra piece of silverware - and responded with peak deadpan restraint.
"You may know what’s coming, Max," the stage host teased as the crowd cheered. "I don’t know," Verstappen replied flatly.

When she announced he had won Formula 1’s Overtake of the Month award and handed him the clear circular trophy to sign for a voting fan, Verstappen offered only a muted, unbothered "Ooh" before glancing behind him at the giant screen replaying the winning move: his pass on Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
Even Verstappen seemed sceptical of the fan vote.
"There’s no way that that won," he said into the microphone while looking back at the replay. Standing to his left, Bearman immediately chimed in: "Was that this month? That was like two months ago."
Holding the signed trophy toward the host, Verstappen asked, "For what month is this?"
"October," she answered.

"October. All right," Verstappen muttered, pausing for a beat before hoisting the trophy half-heartedly into the air with a completely straight face and adding a monotone, "Yes!" The crowd erupted into cheers and laughter, with the host joking, "We’ll take that, Max! We will take that."
The Sepang pass - and Vegas’s overtaking irony

Bearman’s timeline quip was not far off. The relocated Bahrain Grand Prix at Malaysia’s Sepang International Circuit took place nearly seven weeks earlier on 4 October, marking Formula 1’s first visit to the venue since 2017, after the race moved out of the Middle East.

Despite Verstappen’s dry reaction, the move itself proved important to Red Bull’s season. After heavy rain and formation-lap software glitches delayed the start by more than 90 minutes, polesitter Verstappen slipped behind Antonelli and George Russell off the line.

Following an early safety car triggered by Valtteri Bottas - when Red Bull switched to soft slicks against Mercedes’ mediums - Verstappen swept ruthlessly around the outside of Antonelli at Turn 1 on the restart. He never looked back, beating Antonelli by 2.307 seconds to deliver both his first victory of 2026 and the breakthrough maiden win for Red Bull Ford Powertrains.

The fan vote gave Verstappen his third Overtake of the Month trophy of the 2026 campaign after earlier wins in June and July, making him the season’s leading monthly winner heading into the year-end Overtake of the Year poll.

Better still, the comedic stage moment aged quickly on Saturday night. Verstappen won the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix in a chaotic 50-lap race featuring a record 352 overtakes and 35 lead changes - only to label the battery-driven slipstream battles "not F1". If fans hand him November’s trophy too, expect an even flatter reaction.
keyPointsZh: 他获得了本月超车王奖项
keyPointsEn: He received the award at the Las Vegas Grand Prix Fan Forum

detailZh: 维斯塔潘透露他在考虑参加2027年戴通纳24小时耐力赛
维斯塔潘表示他目前正在探索是否有可能参加明年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛。如果他参加，将会驾驶GT3赛车
在Formula 1拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前，维斯塔潘首先访问了戴通纳
这位荷兰人说他主要是去和红牛拍摄内容，但这次访问也引发了是否他真的在认真考虑参加戴通纳国际赛道举行的耐力赛——Rolex 24的疑问。
当Motorsport.com在拉斯维加斯的荷兰媒体会上问他这个问题时，维斯塔潘透露，下个冬天出现在发车线上并不是不可能的。
“我们正在研究这是否可能，但到目前为止，这次访问更多的是关于和红牛拍摄一些东西。”
德托纳是四次F1世界冠军愿望清单上的一项耐力赛。维斯塔潘确认，“那肯定是我想要参加的比赛。”
这也是维斯塔潘在他的F1生涯中已经可以参加的比赛之一，因为这项赛事发生在冬季休赛期。2027年1月28日至31日的第65届德托纳24小时赛计划在这个周末举行。
“是的，那场比赛在我的F1生涯中肯定已经可能了，所以我希望如此。但我们还得再等一会儿[消息]。我们还有时间。”
维斯塔潘明确表示，他将驾驶GT3赛车参加那场比赛，在德托纳意味着参加GTD Pro组别。
在纽博格林北环的冒险之旅以及他在波尔蒂马奥为自己的赛车队做客演出之后，这将标志着维斯塔潘在美国土地上首次参加GT赛车比赛。
至于勒芒24小时耐力赛，维斯塔潘已经表示他明年不会在那里参赛。这位荷兰人只想在勒芒赛道上参加比赛，但需要非常充分的准备，但他解释说，德托纳的情况不同。
“我真的很想在一辆hypercar中参加勒芒。然后你必须仔细考虑你想要如何接近它。你是想自己参加，还是想和一支工厂车队一起参加？我还有时间来解决这个问题。”
“如果我想在德托纳或诺德舍夫勒赛道上比赛，那将会是在GT3赛车中。我不想说这更容易，但相比于hypercar，组织起来要容易一些。”
“当有人指出，维斯塔潘至少会在F1的冬季休赛期给赛车迷们带来一些期待——就像费尔南多·阿隆索将带着达喀尔拉力赛一样——他笑了：“这很好，不是吗？我总是喜欢看到车手们在F1之外做其他事情，并且从其他赛车系列中也能获得乐趣。”"
“当然，F1赛季已经够长了，但如果我能把它与带着家人一起参加活动结合起来，例如，我仍然会尝试参加其他赛事。”"
这很可能也适用于2027年的纽博格林24小时耐力赛，尽管准备阶段的NLS赛事与F1大奖赛相冲突。然而，维斯塔潘笑了，他说：'幸运的是，我已经知道那条赛道！'
#3 梅赛德斯-AMG车队维斯塔潘赛车，梅赛德斯AMG GT3 EVO：维斯塔潘，丹尼尔·胡安卡德拉，朱尔斯·贡农
他仍在考虑安排一个测试日，作为在艾菲尔地区24小时耐力赛准备的一部分。
'是的，但当然你也要考虑赛道，看看哪天可行。但我们将看看是否可以安排另一个测试日，因为这是每个在那里竞争的好车队都会做的事情。所以，是的，这肯定是我们将要考虑的事情之一。'
detailEn: Max Verstappen reveals he is considering 2027 Daytona 24 Hours entry
Verstappen says he is currently exploring whether it would be possible to compete in the Daytona 24 Hours next year. If he does, it would be in a GT3 car
Ahead of the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, Max Verstappen first paid a visit to Daytona.

The Dutchman said he was primarily there to film content with Red Bull, but the visit also raises the question of whether he is seriously considering taking part in the Rolex 24, the endurance race held on the road course of Daytona International Speedway.
When Motorsport.com put that question to him during the Dutch media session in Las Vegas, Verstappen revealed that an appearance on the grid next winter has not been ruled out.
"We're looking into it, whether that's possible, but for now the visit was more about filming things with Red Bull."
Daytona is one of the endurance races high on the four-time F1 world champion's wish list. "That's definitely one that I want to do, yes," Verstappen confirmed.

It is also one of the races Verstappen could already contest during his F1 career, as the event takes place during the winter break. The 65th edition of the Daytona 24 Hours is scheduled for the weekend of 28-31 January 2027.
"Yes, that race is definitely possible already during my F1 career, so I hope so. But we'll have to wait a little longer [for news]. We still have some time for that as well."
Verstappen made it clear that he would contest that race in a GT3 car, which at Daytona would mean competing in the GTD Pro category.
Following his adventures on the Nürburgring Nordschleife and the guest appearance for his own racing team at Portimao, it would mark Verstappen's first GT racing outing on American soil.

As for the Le Mans 24 Hours, Verstappen has already indicated that he will not compete there next year. The Dutchman only wants to race at the Circuit de la Sarthe with very thorough preparation, but he explained that Daytona is a different story.

"I really only want to do Le Mans in a hypercar. And then you have to think carefully about how you want to approach it. Do you want to do it yourself, or do you want to do it with a factory team? I still have time to figure that out as well.
"If I want to race at Daytona, or on the Nordschleife, that would be in a GT3 car. I don't want to say that's easier, but it is a little easier to organise than with a hypercar."

When it was pointed out that Verstappen would at least be giving motorsport fans something to look forward to during the F1 winter break – just as Fernando Alonso will do with the Dakar Rally – he laughed: "That's nice, isn't it? I always enjoy seeing drivers doing other things outside F1 and also getting enjoyment out of other racing series.
"The F1 season is already long enough, of course, but if I can combine it with bringing the family along, for example, then I'll still try to take part in other events."
That will most likely also apply to the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2027, although the preparatory NLS races clash with F1 Grands Prix. Verstappen laughed, however: "Luckily, I already know that track!"
#3 Mercedes-AMG Team Verstappen Racing, Mercedes AMG GT3 EVO: Max Verstappen, Daniel Juncadella, Jules Gounon
He is still considering arranging a test day with his team as part of the preparations for the 24-hour race in the Eifel region.

"Yes, but of course you also have to look at that with the track, to see which days are possible. But we're going to see whether we can schedule another test day, because that's what every good team competing there does. So yes, that's definitely something we're going to look into as well."

items.originalTitle: Andrea Stella warns against knee-jerk reaction as Las Vegas reshapes 2030 debate
items.summaryEn: Less than 24 hours after the FIA confirmed a unanimous framework to introduce simpler 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 engines in 2030, the 50-lap Las Vegas race produced a record 352 overtakes, and McLaren team principal Andrea Stella warned against polarised knee-jerk reactions in the 2030 debate.
detailZh: 安德烈亚·斯特拉警告勿因拉斯维加斯站仓促评判2030年规则辩论
安德烈亚·斯特拉在创下352次超车纪录的拉斯维加斯站让围场意见出现分歧后，警告F1不要做出“两极化”的仓促评判
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，带来车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新消息。
F1离开拉斯维加斯时面对一个尴尬的悖论。国际汽联确认各方一致同意2030年引入更简单的2.1升涡轮增压V8引擎框架后不到24小时——这一举措很大程度上源于对2026年繁重能量管理规则的不满——周六晚的50圈比赛却奉献了本赛季最疯狂的表演之一。
车手们完成了创纪录的352次超车——几乎是2023年赞德沃特站创下的186次原纪录的两倍——此外还有35次领先位置变化。迈凯伦利用了梅赛德斯后期的戏剧性变故，兰多·诺里斯以0.639秒之差落后于冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘获得亚军，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里则从第17位一路飙升至第三。
然而，当在赛后媒体环节被问及一个矛盾——用国际汽联一级方程式计划要摒弃的同一套能量管理“人为手段”来呈现一场令人难忘的奇观——迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉拒绝采取简单化的立场。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
“很难有一个简单的立场，或者简单到说‘哦，这就是我们想要的比赛’，因为一旦你这么说，你就会看到其他一些值得考虑的重要视角，”斯特拉说。“我还得和兰多、奥斯卡谈谈，了解他们：你们享受其中吗？还是说有点太过头了，有时感觉从安全角度看这要出大问题。”
“我不想表达一个净立场，因为事实上，我并没有这样的立场，”他补充道。“这场比赛给了我们很多不能忽视的信息。”
围场在《马里奥赛车》与纯粹观赏性之间分裂
维修区内的即时反应已经出现分歧。维斯塔潘将车阵的来回洗牌比作“玩《马里奥赛车》”，其中掉队会触发追赶气流。凯迪拉克的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯批评这种比赛“非常人为”。
诺里斯语气复杂，指出20至30公里/小时的接近速度意味着“有些超车并不是超车——你按下加速，就超过了某人”，同时想象如果没有电池妥协，2030年的比赛会有多强。与此同时，卡洛斯·塞恩斯享受这场战斗，威廉姆斯队友亚历克斯·阿尔本则欢迎在纯速度赛道之外偶尔来一场“接力棒比赛”。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦；兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
在斯特拉看来，这种分歧恰恰说明，在下个月于上海举行的国际汽联世界汽车运动理事会就2030年框架进行投票之前，F1必须抵制条件反射式的裁决。
“我的主要建议是，我们要保持一种分析性的态度，并继续关心这项运动的利益，”斯特拉说。“我们生活在一个必须在一秒内拿出观点的世界里，否则你就无足轻重。你的观点必须是两极化的，否则你就无足轻重。”
他警告说，“如果只用一场激烈复盘的时间来处理这件事，然后说‘哦，让我们放弃新规则吧’，那将是一种遗憾。”
detailEn: Andrea Stella warns against knee-jerk reaction as Las Vegas reshapes 2030 debate
Andrea Stella warns F1 against "polarised" hot takes after the record 352-overtake Las Vegas GP splits paddock opinion
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

Formula 1 left Las Vegas facing an awkward paradox. Barely 24 hours after the FIA confirmed unanimous agreement on a framework to introduce simpler, 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 engines in 2030 - a move driven largely by frustration over 2026’s heavy energy-management rules - Saturday night’s 50-lap race produced one of the wildest shows of the season.

Drivers completed a record 352 overtakes - nearly double the previous mark of 186 set at Zandvoort in 2023 - alongside 35 lead changes. McLaren cashed in on late Mercedes drama as Lando Norris finished 0.639 seconds behind winner Max Verstappen and Oscar Piastri surged from 17th to third.

Yet when asked in his post-race media session about the contradiction of staging an unforgettable spectacle using the same energy-management "artificialities" F1 plans to move past, McLaren team principal Andrea Stella refused to take a simplistic stance.
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren

"It’s very difficult to have a simple position, or a position as simple as saying, 'Oh, that’s the race we want,' because as soon as you say that, you will see some other perspectives which are important to consider," Stella said. "I still have to talk to Lando and Oscar and understand: did you enjoy it? Or that was kind of too much, and at times it felt like this is going to go very wrong from a safety point of view.
"I don’t want to express a net position, because in fact, I don’t have it," he added. "This race gave us a lot of information that we cannot ignore."
Paddock split between Mario Kart and pure spectacle

Instant reactions down the pitlane were already split. Verstappen likened the pack shuffling to "playing Mario Kart," where dropping back triggered catch-up drafts. Cadillac’s Sergio Perez criticised the racing as "very artificial".

Norris struck a mixed tone, noting 20–30 km/h closing speeds meant "some of the overtakes weren't overtakes - you press boost, and you go past someone," while imagining how strong 2030’s racing could look without battery compromises. Meanwhile, Carlos Sainz enjoyed the fight, and Williams team-mate Alex Albon welcomed an occasional "baton race" alongside pure-pace circuits.
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren
For Stella, that divide shows why F1 must resist knee-jerk verdicts ahead of next month’s FIA World Motor Sport Council vote in Shanghai on the 2030 framework.

"My main recommendation is that we remain kind of analytical, and we remain caring for the interests of the sport," Stella said. "We live in a world in which you need to have an opinion in one second, otherwise you are a nobody. You need to have an opinion that is polarised, otherwise you are a nobody."
He warned it "would be a shame to process it in the space of a hot review and say, 'Oh, let’s abandon the new regulations.'"

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris: "Looking at the battery more than where I'm going" in Las Vegas
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯：在拉斯维加斯，'我更多地关注电池而不是我要去哪里'
这个结果让诺里斯在锦标赛中排名第五，与乔治·拉塞尔积分相同
对于麦凯轮车迷来说，来自沃金克的木瓜新闻，有关车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的每一场比赛的最新消息。
麦凯轮一级方程式车手兰多·诺里斯表示，在拉斯维加斯大奖赛中，他花更多的时间关注电池而不是前方的道路，因为他从积分榜外恢复到第二名。
2025年的冠军起步排在第三位，但在第12圈时已经落后到了第11位，MCL40在拉斯维加斯街道赛道的长直道上失去了优势。
诺里斯在赛后已经表示这辆车在直线上的表现‘糟糕’，比赛的开局几圈也证明了这一点。
‘在比赛一开始，我只是在尝试了解电池的情况。我总是感觉处于不利的一方。每次被超越，我的电池电量不足，而别人后面有更多的电池电量，我就一直掉队，’他在赛后新闻发布会上解释道。
‘整个比赛都在判断电池电量。我观察电池的时间比观察我在赛道上的行驶时间还要多。所以这是最重要的事情。’
安全车被叫出，这是由于塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和拉斐尔·卡马拉发生碰撞，帮助诺里斯重新回到竞争行列。
第一节的节奏和第二节一样好。只是我们在直道上的防御太脆弱了。大部分时间都在尝试找出在哪里使用电池，在哪里不要使用。
我必须每圈按九个按钮，试图做正确的事情，让电池按照应有的方式工作，给我们自己一点机会。因为我们直线上的速度比其他人慢，我们不得不做很多事情来尝试给自己任何希望。
赛季还剩下两轮，在卡塔尔和阿布扎比，诺里斯目前在车手积分榜上排名第五，积264分，与梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔积分相同，他在拉斯维加斯大奖赛之后下滑到第四。
detailEn: Lando Norris: "Looking at the battery more than where I'm going" in Las Vegas
The result leaves Norris fifth in the championship, level on points with George Russell
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
McLaren Formula 1 driver Lando Norris says he spent more of the Las Vegas Grand Prix watching his battery than the road ahead, as he recovered from outside the points to second place.
The 2025 champion started third but was running 11th by lap 12, with the MCL40 losing out on the Las Vegas street circuit's long straights.
Norris had already called the car "awful in the straight" after qualifying, and the opening laps showed why.

"It was just, at the very beginning of the race, I was just trying to figure out the battery. I always just seemed to be on the bad side. Every time I got overtaken, I had no battery, someone else had more battery behind, and I just kept dropping back," he explained during the post-race press conference.
"The whole race was judging battery the whole time. I'm looking at the battery more than I'm looking where I'm going around this track. So it's the most important thing."
The safety car, called when Sergio Perez and Rafael Camara collided, helped Norris get back into contention.

"The pace was just as good in the first stint as it was in the second. It was just we were so vulnerable down the straight. A lot of it was just trying to figure out where to use the battery, where not to.

"I must be pressing like nine buttons a lap, trying to just get the correct things and make the battery work as it should and give ourselves a bit of a chance. Because we were so slow in the straights compared to others, we just had to do a lot to try and give ourselves any hope."

With two rounds remaining of the season, in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, Norris currently sits fifth in the drivers' championship with 264 points, level on points with Mercedes' George Russell, who slipped to fourth after the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
